component.name: Fine Artist
component.summary: Run the 1990s children's painting program , Spanish edition, on Linux
Ejecuta en Linux el programa de pintura infantil de los años 90 (edición en español)

description.p: A native Linux runtime for Fine Artist, the 1990s Windows 3.1 painting program for children. It loads your original program files and runs them without Wine and without Windows.

This package contains no Microsoft software. You need your own copy of the CD (or its disc image), the Spanish disks; the first start asks where it is and remembers it. Your users and documents are kept in ~/.local/share/cwfa/data-es, and printing saves PDF files in your Documents folder.

Un runtime nativo de Linux para Fine Artist, el programa de pintura para niños de Windows 3.1 de los años 90, en su edición en español. Carga tus archivos originales y los ejecuta sin Wine y sin Windows. Este paquete no contiene software de Microsoft: necesitas tu propia copia de los discos.
